submission.comment: Best strategy found: breakout with 17-day lookback and volatility targeting. Achieves 1.071 annualized Sharpe ratio with 51.3% annual return, 47.9% annual volatility, and 45.1% max drawdown. The breakout family significantly outperformed other strategy families on this crypto asset, with the 17-day lookback being optimal. Volatility targeting improves risk-adjusted returns by reducing drawdowns while maintaining returns.
